data: Is the orange dashed line in the bottom right plot consistently above the blue solid line?

The orange dashed line in the bottom right plot is not consistently above the blue solid line. The orange dashed line represents the performance of the Attention-Informed Mixed Training (Att.) model with 100% training data, while the blue solid line represents the performance of the model by varying the proportion of training data size. In some cases, the blue solid line is above the orange dashed line, indicating that the model performs better than the Att. model when the proportion of training data size is smaller. Therefore, the orange dashed line is not consistently above the blue solid line.
